name: e2e-cpp-monorepo
description: MIT-based E2E framework with extensible CLI, terminal, HTTP and native Qt engines

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/core run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/process run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/checks run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/protocol run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/native run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/terminal run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/playwright run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/agent-device run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/github run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/oauth run build
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:dead-code && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run docs:check-errors && pnpm run docs:check
scripts.canary: node scripts/canary-changeset.ts && changeset version --snapshot canary && pnpm run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/core run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/process run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/checks run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/protocol run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/native run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/terminal run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/playwright run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/agent-device run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/github run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/oauth run test && pnpm run test:scripts
scripts.build:cpp: pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/core run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/process run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/checks run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/protocol run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/native run build && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/terminal run build
scripts.test:cpp: pnpm run build:cpp && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/process run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/checks run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/protocol run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/native run test && pnpm --filter @e2e-cpp/terminal run test
scripts.check:local: pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:dead-code && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run docs:check-errors && pnpm run docs:check
